rationale: Cluster [validate_failed::workflow-section] for t02-chinese-alias: the produced pack was missing provenance entirely because the Workflow never made provenance stamping an explicit, mandatory gate of Extract+Validate. Just listing E15 in the cheat sheet is insufficient — the Workflow must require non-empty provenance maps as a green-bar condition. Adding a named sub-gate inside step 4 prevents silent data-loss for every archetype, not just Chinese-alias.
expected_effect: Provenance stamping is now an explicit, named gate of the Extract+Validate step. Agents that previously skipped provenance (as in t02-chinese-alias) will be prompted to verify all three provenance maps are non-empty AND pass E15 before declaring green, eliminating the silent-data-loss failure. This applies to every archetype, not just Chinese-alias.
regression_risk: A slightly stricter gate on the extract step could cause green-runs to be reported as failed if provenance wiring is incomplete in the extraction config. Mitigated by clear remediation instructions (add `withProvenance(...)`, un-skip entity kinds). No regression for the three passing tasks (id-based, multi-stage, external-json) since they already produce provenance — only the gate-check is new.
